description:
Miko Mido has fallen in love for the first time. Too bad for her that she hasn't the time to pursue the man of her dreams. There is a mysterious female ghost which is attacking Miko's schoolmates and stealing their life-force, and someone has to investigate the case. However, it seems that the ominous phantom is willing to pursue Miko's love interest, too...

(Source: Anime News Network)
